item.title: microgpt-c Part 1: Automatic Differentiation and Baseline Performance
item.description: microgpt, by Andrej Karpathy is a 200 line python implementation of GPT-2. It is trained on a set of names, and attempts to train a model to generate new ones. Following this, I wanted to try porting it to C as an exercise in learning the language. This post will lay out my approach to implementing an autodifferentiation engine with nothing but the C standard library. It’s recommended that one reads the original post, along with growingswe’s visual explainer for more background on GPT-2 itself.
